comments.author: Blueve
Blueve
comments.body:
Plan to add new topo `m0`
M0 is now a brand new role in network, it is partially act as a T0 and partially act as a T1.
It is not need to run all T0 test suite because M0 usually don't have too much overhead and no need some advanced feature like pfc/vxlan/everflow/...
It has some similarity with T1 because for some devices that don't have mgmt port, it will have BGP to collect devices' loopback to let user access them and manage them. And M0 can also have next layer (in-rack mgmt_switch, we called Mx), so it will also need to fwd DHCP Relay packet correctly just like T1.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
For mgmt tor router, both testing methodology and physical wiring pattern are quite different with existing T0/T1/ topo. Adding this topo can let us filter unrelated test cases from mgmt network.

#### How did you do it?
* Add a new topo (inherit from t0-52)
* Enhance topo config and topo_facts for including interfaces
* Enhance minigraph templates to support generate minigraph for this new topo

#### How did you verify/test it?
Generate minigraph and deploy to DUT.
Use ./testbed-cli.sh deploy-mg to gen&deploy minigraph with new topo m0 successfully,
All the related configuration are correct pushed to DUT after deploy.
